title: Wage Earner Protection Program Act
verified_how: Fetched the index page: title 'Wage Earner Protection Program Act', citation (S.C. 2005, c. 47, s. 1), current to 2026-07-21, last amended 2021-11-20.
notes: Pays unpaid wages, vacation, severance and termination pay when an employer goes bankrupt or into receivership. Applies to all employees in Canada, not only federally regulated ones.
